case.description: laminar mixed convection, vertical pipe, buoyancy-assisting, constant wall heat flux

truth_independence.open_issue: prior implementation marked this substrate divergent_truth_substrate=False; unresolved

reproduction_agreement.purpose: Fixed before any rebuilt number exists. Determines whether the reconstruction may be described as reproducing the original results, or supersedes them.

preconditions.note: Both are set at lock time and never afterwards. The width cap prevents a wide, powerless interval from making agreement automatic.

qualitative_claims: precision advantage over both baselines, unconditional across the theta sweep
f1 advantage over both baselines, conditional

outcomes.REPRODUCED: preconditions pass AND all three original values inside their intervals AND all three qualitative claims hold
outcomes.SUPERSEDED: preconditions pass AND at least one original value outside its interval

reproduction_agreement.invariant: In every outcome the numbers presented are the reconstruction's, never the original's. The original triple is never presented as a number this repository produces.
